name: Extracurricular / Cocurricular Eligibility Standards for Board Approval
description: Superintendent prepares and presents eligibility standards for Board consideration; Board must be informed and approve standards and any changes before they take effect.
deadline: before standards or changes become operable
quote: The Superintendent shall prepare and present to the Board for its consideration, these standards of eligibility to be met by all students participating in extracurricular and cocurricular activities. The Superintendent shall secure Board approval before making any changes to the eligibility standards once approved by the Board.
